Read by scripts/Deploy-Synapse.ps1 and translated into the module's own
IMPORTANT - what this tool does and does NOT deploy:
DOES deploy   workspace artifacts - linked services, datasets, notebooks,
SQL script tabs, Synapse pipelines, triggers, Spark job
definitions. These live in the workspace's own artifact store
and are reached through the Dev API (<ws>.dev.azuresynapse.net).
Does NOT deploy   anything INSIDE the serverless SQL database. Databases,
schemas, external data sources, file formats, views and
procedures are ordinary T-SQL objects. No artifact API can
create them; they need a SQL connection.
That second point is the most common misconception about deploying Synapse.
A SQL script artifact is a saved query TAB in Studio - deploying it does not
execute anything. src/synapse/serverless/*.sql is therefore deployed by
scripts/Deploy-ServerlessSql.ps1 over TDS, as a separate step in
Option semantics mirror the ADF module - see src/adf/deployment/publish-options.json.
